def gdp(
        self,
        *,
        start_quarter: str,
        end_quarter: str,
    ) -> tuple[ContextScalar, ...]:
        start_value = _quarter_value(start_quarter)
        end_value = _quarter_value(end_quarter)
        if _quarter_ordinal(end_value) < _quarter_ordinal(start_value):
            raise ValueError("tushare_quarter_range_invalid")
        fields = (
            ("total", "gdp", "gdp_yoy"),
            ("primary", "pi", "pi_yoy"),
            ("secondary", "si", "si_yoy"),
            ("tertiary", "ti", "ti_yoy"),
        )
        rows = self._call(
            "cn_gdp",
            {"start_q": start_value, "end_q": end_value},
            (
                "quarter",
                *(field for _aggregate, level, yoy in fields for field in (level, yoy)),
            ),
        )
        scalars: list[ContextScalar] = []
        for row in rows:
            year_start, quarter_start, quarter_end = _quarter_bounds(str(row.get("quarter")))
            for aggregate, level_field, yoy_field in fields:
                level = _number(row.get(level_field))
                if level is not None:
                    scalars.append(
                        ContextScalar(
                            metric_id="CN_GDP",
                            api_name="cn_gdp",
                            source_field=level_field,
                            period_kind="year_to_quarter",
                            period_start=year_start,
                            period_end=quarter_end,
                            dimensions={
                                "aggregate": aggregate,
                                "measure": "nominal_ytd_level",
                            },
                            value=level,
                            unit="hundred_million_cny",
                        )
                    )
                yoy = _number(row.get(yoy_field))
                if yoy is not None:
                    scalars.append(
                        ContextScalar(
                            metric_id="CN_GDP",
                            api_name="cn_gdp",
                            source_field=yoy_field,
                            period_kind="quarter",
                            period_start=quarter_start,
                            period_end=quarter_end,
                            dimensions={
                                "aggregate": aggregate,
                                "measure": "real_quarter_yoy",
                            },
                            value=yoy,
                            unit="percent",
                        )
                    )
        return tuple(scalars)

def _metric_rows(
    repository: EvidenceRepository,
    definition: MetricDefinition,
    *,
    as_of: datetime,
    as_of_mode: AsOfMode,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], ...]:
    series = repository.metric_series(
        definition.metric_id,
        mode=as_of_mode,
        as_of=as_of,
        definition_version=definition.definition_version,
    )
    release_status = _release_status(
        repository,
        definition,
        as_of=as_of,
        as_of_mode=as_of_mode,
    )
    grouped: dict[str, list[MetricSeriesPoint]] = {}
    for point in series:
        grouped.setdefault(json.dumps(point.dimensions, sort_keys=True), []).append(point)
    if not grouped:
        history_lookup = getattr(repository, "has_target_history", None)
        if (
            definition.frequency == "event"
            and callable(history_lookup)
            and history_lookup(
                definition.metric_id,
                mode=as_of_mode,
                as_of=as_of,
                definition_version=definition.definition_version,
            )
        ):
            release_status = "no_event_in_visible_window"
        return (_gap_row(definition, release_status=release_status),)
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for points in grouped.values():
        current = points[-1]
        previous = points[-2] if len(points) > 1 else None
        selected = next(
            (claim for claim in current.claims if claim.claim_id == current.selected_claim_id),
            None,
        )
        status = _evidence_status(
            definition,
            current,
            selected,
            as_of=as_of,
            release_status=release_status,
        )
        candidate_value = current.selected_value
        value = (
            None if status == "awaiting_source_certification" else candidate_value
        )
        rows.append(
            {
                "available_at": selected.available_at.isoformat() if selected is not None else None,
                "certification_status": (
                    selected.certification_status
                    if selected is not None
                    else definition.certification_status
                ),
                "claim_ids": [claim.claim_id for claim in current.claims],
                "claims": [
                    {
                        "available_at": claim.available_at.isoformat(),
                        "certification_status": claim.certification_status,
                        "claim_id": claim.claim_id,
                        "provider": claim.provider,
                        "public_available_at": (
                            claim.public_available_at.isoformat()
                            if claim.public_available_at is not None
                            else None
                        ),
                        "quality_status": claim.quality_status,
                        "selected": claim.claim_id == current.selected_claim_id,
                        "source_reference": claim.source_reference,
                        "unit": claim.unit,
                        "value": (
                            None
                            if status == "awaiting_source_certification"
                            else claim.value
                        ),
                        "value_state": claim.value_state.value,
                    }
                    for claim in current.claims
                ],
                "dimensions": current.dimensions,
                "direction": _raw_direction(
                    definition.metric_id,
                    value,
                    (
                        previous.selected_value
                        if previous is not None
                        and status != "awaiting_source_certification"
                        else None
                    ),
                    current.dimensions,
                ),
                "metric_id": definition.metric_id,
                "observation_id": current.observation_id,
                "period_start": current.period_start,
                "period": current.period_end,
                "public_available_at": (
                    selected.public_available_at.isoformat()
                    if selected is not None and selected.public_available_at is not None
                    else None
                ),
                "quality_status": selected.quality_status if selected is not None else None,
                "selected_claim_id": current.selected_claim_id,
                "source_reference": selected.source_reference if selected is not None else None,
                "status": status,
                "unit": selected.unit if selected is not None else definition.unit,
                "value": value,
                "value_state": (
                    current.value_state.value if current.value_state is not None else None
                ),
            }
        )
    return tuple(rows)


def _gap_row(
    definition: MetricDefinition,
    *,
    release_status: str | None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "available_at": None,
        "certification_status": definition.certification_status,
        "claim_ids": [],
        "claims": [],
        "dimensions": {},
        "direction": "unknown",
        "metric_id": definition.metric_id,
        "observation_id": f"gap:{definition.metric_id}",
        "period_start": None,
        "period": None,
        "public_available_at": None,
        "quality_status": None,
        "selected_claim_id": None,
        "source_reference": None,
        "status": release_status
        or (
            "awaiting_source_certification"
            if definition.certification_status != "certified"
            else "missing"
        ),
        "unit": definition.unit,
        "value": None,
        "value_state": None,
    }


def _evidence_status(
    definition: MetricDefinition,
    point: MetricSeriesPoint,
    selected: Any,
    *,
    as_of: datetime,
    release_status: str | None,
) -> str:
    if definition.certification_status != "certified":
        return "awaiting_source_certification"
    if point.selection_status == "conflicted":
        return "conflicted"
    if selected is None:
        return "missing"
    if selected.certification_status != "certified":
        return "awaiting_source_certification"
    if selected.quality_status != "validated":
        return "source_failed"
    if point.value_state is not EvidenceValueState.REPORTED_VALUE:
        return point.value_state.value if point.value_state is not None else "missing"
    if release_status is not None and release_status != "current":
        return release_status
    period_date = date.fromisoformat(point.period_end)
    age = (as_of.date() - period_date).days
    limit = (
        730
        if definition.metric_id == "CN_RRR_EVENT"
        else {"daily": 10, "monthly": 95, "quarterly": 190, "event": 370}.get(
            definition.frequency,
            95,
        )
    )
    return "stale" if age > limit else "current"

def _integer(value: object) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str) and value.isdigit():
        return int(value)
    return 0

def parse_official_context_document(
    content: bytes,
    *,
    family: str,
    source_url: str,
    expected_period: str,
    fetched_at: datetime,
    parser_text_limit: int | None = None,
) -> ParsedOfficialContextRelease:
    provider = _validate_source_identity(family, source_url)
    if fetched_at.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("official_context_fetched_at_must_be_timezone_aware")
    if not content or len(content) > MAX_OFFICIAL_CONTEXT_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("official_context_document_size_invalid")
    document = _decode_document(content)
    parser = _OfficialHtmlParser()
    parser.feed(document)
    text = _normalized_text(" ".join(parser.parts))
    if parser_text_limit is not None and len(text) > parser_text_limit:
        raise ValueError("official_parser_fragment_too_large")
    source_timezone = ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")
    published = _release_timestamp(text)
    release_at, public_at = publication_times(published, source_timezone)
    if release_at is not None:
        release_at = release_at.astimezone(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
        public_at = release_at
    if release_at is not None and fetched_at < release_at:
        raise ValueError("official_context_fetched_before_release")
    if (
        published is not None
        and not isinstance(published, datetime)
        and fetched_at.astimezone(source_timezone).date() < published
    ):
        raise ValueError("official_context_fetched_before_release")
    if not _period_is_identified(text, expected_period):
        raise ValueError("official_context_period_identity_mismatch")
    scalars = _parse_family(family, parser.tables, text, expected_period, release_at)
    return ParsedOfficialContextRelease(
        family=family,
        provider=provider,
        release_event_id=f"official:{family}:{expected_period}:{hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()}",
        period=expected_period,
        release_at=release_at,
        public_available_at=public_at,
        source_url=source_url,
        scalars=scalars,
